title: Specialty Coffee Subscription Market 2025 (fictional)
text: Specialty coffee subscriptions reached US$ 2.4 billion in 2025, up 18% from 2024. Analysts expect the segment to grow 11% a year until 2028.

title: Consumer Panel: Who Subscribes (fictional)
text: A panel of 3,200 buyers found 61% subscribe for convenience and 27% for discovery of new roasters. Households of 2 to 3 people buy 1 bag every 12 days.

title: Pricing Benchmark: Whole Bean Bags (fictional)
text: The median 250 g bag costs US$ 14.50 on subscription and US$ 16.90 on single purchase. Plans with free shipping above US$ 35 raise basket size by 22%.

title: Competitor Scan: Five Regional Players (fictional)
text: Five regional roasters hold 38% of subscription revenue. The largest, Bean Harbor, has 120,000 subscribers; the others each have under 40,000.

title: Retention Study: First 90 Days (fictional)
text: Monthly churn is 9% in the first three months and 4% afterwards. Subscribers who can skip a month cancel 31% less often.

title: Channel Mix Report (fictional)
text: Direct website sales account for 54% of subscriptions, marketplaces 29% and grocery partnerships 17%. Paid social acquisition costs US$ 38 per subscriber.

title: Logistics Cost Note (fictional)
text: Shipping a 250 g bag costs US$ 4.80 on average, 33% of the subscription price. Roasting to order cuts stale-stock returns from 6% to 2%.

title: Competitor Pricing Move (fictional)
text: Bean Harbor lowered its entry plan to US$ 12.90 in September 2025 and added a skip-a-month option.
